command:
cargo build -p pilotdeck-agent-loop --release && ./target/release/pilotdeck-agent-loop --listen 127.0.0.1:37211  # reuse listener, host is connect-only
# then 30 times:
python3 tools/agent-loop-parity/run.py --pilotdeck-root "$PWD" --comparison same-version --surface gateway --sidecar-transport tcp --pilotdeck-tcp-host 127.0.0.1 --pilotdeck-tcp-port 37211 --scenario pure_text --adapter-timeout-seconds 120 --output /tmp/t-p1-03-pr-b-raw/pure_text/run-NN
